records.jp: ようこそ、私のコモンへ
records.en_original: Welcome to my Common.
records.en: Welcome to my Common.

records.jp: し、紫乃ちゃん！！
records.en_original: Sh-Shino!
records.en: Sh-Shino-chan!

records.jp: ふふっ、何を驚いてるんですか？<CR>私に話があってここまで来たのでしょう？
records.en_original: Hehe, what's got you so startled? You came all the way here because you wanted to talk to me, didn't you?
records.en: Hehe, what's got you so startled? You came all the way here because you wanted to talk to me, didn't you?

records.jp: だからわざわざこうして、私の方からお姉さんたちを<CR>出迎えに来たというのに
records.en_original: So I thought I would do you the favor of coming to greet you.
records.en: So I thought I would do you the favor of coming to greet you.

records.jp: そう。私たちはあなたを止めに来た
records.en_original: Yes. We're here to stop you.
records.en: Yes. We're here to stop you.

records.jp: 紫乃ちゃんの願う世界を創るために、<CR>今の世界を終わらせるなんて……させられない
records.en_original: There's no way we'll let you end this world just to create the one you're envisioning, Shino.
records.en: There's no way we'll let you end this world just to create the one you're envisioning, Shino-chan.

records.jp: ……お姉さんたちは、<CR>今の世界が正しいと思えるんですか？
records.en_original: Do you really believe this world, in its current form, is as it should be?
records.en: Do you really believe this world, in its current form, is as it should be?

records.jp: 大勢の少女たちが苦しみ、傷ついているというのに、<CR>救いの手が差し伸べられないこの世界のことを
records.en_original: Even though so many girls are suffering and hurting, and no helping hand ever reaches out to them?
records.en: Even though so many girls are suffering and hurting, and no helping hand ever reaches out to them?

records.jp: そ、それは……
records.en_original: Th-that's...
records.en: Th-that's...

records.jp: 星ノ宮で誰かが時を戻したおかげで、<CR>この世界は二度目のチャンスを手に入れた
records.en_original: Thanks to someone turning back time at Hoshinomiya, this world was given a second chance.
records.en: Thanks to someone turning back time at Hoshinomiya, this world was given a second chance.

records.jp: にもかかわらず、世界は変わらなかった……。<CR>変わろうとしなかった
records.en_original: And yet, the world stayed the same... It refuses to budge.
records.en: And yet, the world stayed the same... It refuses to budge.

records.jp: それが答えです。<CR>今の世界は、正しくあるのを拒んでいるんです
records.en_original: Therein lies the answer. This world refuses to change. It will never get better.
records.en: Therein lies the answer. This world refuses to change. It will never get better.

records.jp: だからこそ、終わらせる必要があるんですよ。<CR>そして正しい世界を創れるのは、私だけ
records.en_original: That's why it needs to end. And I'm the only one who can create a new, worthy world.
records.en: That's why it needs to end. And I'm the only one who can create a new, worthy world.

records.jp: 紫乃……どれだけ取り返しのつかないことを<CR>してきたのか、忘れたの？
records.en_original: Shino...have you forgotten all the things you've done that can't be undone?
records.en: Shino...have you forgotten all the things you've done that can't be undone?

records.jp: 大勢のフラグメントを奪うのもそうだし、<CR>リフレクターたちを利用し、洗脳までした
records.en_original: You've stolen countless Fragments, used the Reflectors as pawns—even brainwashed them.
records.en: You've stolen countless Fragments, used the Reflectors as pawns—even brainwashed them.

records.jp: そんなやり方しかできないあなたに、<CR>本当に正しい世界が創れると思ってるの？
records.en_original: Do you really think someone as underhanded as you can create a just world?
records.en: Do you really think someone as underhanded as you can create a just world?

records.jp: 逆です。そこまで望む私だからこそ、創れるんです
records.en_original: You've got it backwards. My uncompromising desire is proof that I can create it.
records.en: You've got it backwards. My uncompromising desire is proof that I can create it.

records.jp: 私は、正しい世界を創らなければならない。<CR>少女たちが傷つかない世界を創れるのは、私だけ
records.en_original: I have to create a just world—one where girls like us don't get hurt. I'm the only one who can.
records.en: I have to create a just world—one where girls like us don't get hurt. I'm the only one who can.

records.jp: ……私ね、紫乃ちゃんがそう思う気持ち、<CR>正直理解できるよ
records.en_original: You know, Shino... I honestly understand how you feel.
records.en: You know, Shino-chan... I honestly understand how you feel.

records.jp: 正しい世界を望むのだって、間違ってないと思う。<CR>けど……
records.en_original: Wishing for a just world isn't wrong. But...
records.en: Wishing for a just world isn't wrong. But...

records.jp: 紫乃ちゃんのやり方は正しくない。<CR>絶対に間違ってるから、放っておけないよ
records.en_original: The way you're going about it isn't right. It's absolutely wrong, and I can't ignore that.
records.en: Shino-chan's way isn't right.<CR>It's absolutely wrong, so I can't just leave her be.

records.jp: はい、そうでしょうね。<CR>愚かなお姉さんたちなら、そう言うと思ってました
records.en_original: I expected as much. A foolish bunch of girls like you could only ever see it that way.
records.en: I expected as much. A foolish bunch of girls like you could only ever see it that way.

records.jp: けど、私の気持ちも理解してくれているというのは、<CR>嬉しい限りです
records.en_original: Even so, I'm truly glad you can understand how I feel.
records.en: Even so, I'm truly glad you can understand how I feel.

records.jp: その理解、もう少しだけ深めてもらえませんか？
records.en_original: Won't you try to understand my perspective just a tiny bit more?
records.en: Won't you try to understand my perspective just a tiny bit more?

records.jp: きゃああああああっ！！
records.en_original: Kyaaaaaah!
records.en: Kyaaaaaah!

records.jp: うあああああああっ！！
records.en_original: Yaaaaaah!
records.en: Yaaaaaah!

records.jp: 寄り添うことのできない優しさは残酷です。<CR>お姉さんたちにはそんなの似合いませんよ
records.en_original: Kindness that forces you to turn your back on others is just cruelty. That sort of behavior doesn't suit you two at all.
records.en: Kindness that forces you to turn your back on others is just cruelty. That sort of behavior doesn't suit you two at all.

records.jp: コモンの番人……私に勝てないのを承知で、<CR>健気なものですね
records.en_original: The guardians of the Common... You know you can't beat me, yet still you valiantly try.
records.en: The guardians of the Common... You know you can't beat me, yet still you valiantly try.

records.jp: だとしても、この二人を好きにはさせない
records.en_original: Even if we can't, we won't let you take their hearts.
records.en: Even if we can't, we won't let you take their hearts.

records.jp: 陽桜莉ちゃんと瑠夏ちゃんは、<CR>あなたを止める希望だから
records.en_original: We know that Hiori and Ruka will stop you.
records.en: We know that Hiori-chan and Ruka-chan will stop you.

records.jp: だとしたら、一足遅かったかもしれませんね
records.en_original: In that case, you might be just a little too late.
records.en: In that case, you might be just a little too late.

records.jp: ……どういうこと？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: さあ？　私はコモンの奥で待っていますので、<CR>止める気なら、いつでも来ていただいていいですよ
records.en_original: Who knows? I'll be waiting at the far end of the Common. Stop by whenever you like if you truly intend to stop me.
records.en: Who knows? I'll be waiting at the far end of the Common. Stop by whenever you like if you truly intend to stop me.

records.jp: まあ、お姉さんたちがどう思うかは知りませんが
records.en_original: Well, not that I care what you two do.
records.en: Well, not that I care what you two do.

records.jp: 二人とも！
records.en_original: No!
records.en: No!

records.jp: どうしよう、息してない！
records.en_original: What should we do? They're not breathing!
records.en: What should we do? They're not breathing!

records.jp: 大丈夫、まだ助けられるはず。<CR>ユズ、二人に力を
records.en_original: It's okay, there's still time for us to save them. Let's lend them our power, Yuzu!
records.en: It's okay, there's still time for us to save them. Let's lend them our power, Yuzu!

records.jp: う、うん、わかった
records.en_original: Y-yeah, got it.
records.en: Y-yeah, got it.

records.jp: 陽桜莉ちゃん、瑠夏ちゃん……目を覚まして
records.en_original: Hiori, Ruka...please, wake up!
records.en: Hiori-chan, Ruka-chan...please, wake up!

records.jp: 二人とも、頑張って！
records.en_original: You can do it, you two!
records.en: You can do it, you two!

records.jp: 尊い想いの溢れる、この世界を守るために
records.en_original: To protect this world, overflowing with precious feelings.
records.en: To protect this world, overflowing with precious feelings.
